title: Global Mean Surface Temperatures for 100 Phanerozoic Time Intervals
authors: Scotese, C. R. (2021); maps derived from Valdes, Scotese & Lunt (2021) HadCM3L runs nudged to proxy data
cite: Scotese, C. R., Song, H., Mills, B. J. W., & van der Meer, D. G. (2021). Phanerozoic paleotemperatures: The earth's changing climate during the last 540 million years. Earth-Science Reviews, 215, 103503. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.earscirev.2021.103503
Valdes, P. J., Scotese, C. R., & Lunt, D. J. (2021). Deep ocean temperatures through time. Climate of the Past, 17, 1483-1506. https://doi.org/10.5194/cp-17-1483-2021
note: 100 surface air temperature maps, 1 degree, degrees Celsius, 0-450 Ma every 5 Myr then every 10 Myr to 540 Ma. NetCDF set only; the CSV sets are the same data. Files are named <age>_tas_scotese02a_v21321.nc with northing 90..-90 and easting -180..180.
